purpose: Known nearest-neighbor collisions to test, not a list of approved ideas.

operation_families.collision_test: If the proposal only stores or retrieves textual lessons, state why it is not one of these memory updates.
If the proposal explores alternatives, identify the search state, expansion rule, evaluator, and cost delta.
If the proposal critiques and retries, name the new information unavailable to ordinary tool-grounded revision.
If the proposal constrains actions, distinguish an algorithmic update from an interface or pipeline redesign.
If the proposal adds trace metrics, show what policy or state transition the diagnostic changes.

cross_domain_collisions.shared_observation: A local success precedes a global acceptance failure.
Narrative or surface evidence claims a behavior that executable state does not contain.
A hidden relation or environment variable invalidates an otherwise plausible action.
